name: @inbox/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the Unified Inbox API (web and React Native). Types are generated from apps/api/openapi/openapi.yaml.

scripts.check-generated: openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/openapi.yaml -o .schema.check.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('src/schema.ts','utf8'),b=fs.readFileSync('.schema.check.ts','utf8');fs.unlinkSync('.schema.check.ts');if(a!==b){console.error('src/schema.ts is out of date: run npm run generate -w packages/sdk');process.exit(1)}"
